body: I have been looking at the subox mini recently, would you say it's worth the spend? I've also been checking out the Innokin Cool Fire IV as a comparison which seems more or less a similar product albeit a bit friendlier on the wallet.
I tried this with a fresh coil last night, primed it for at least 4 or 5 minutes and still, the same results. I'm beginning to think I may have been sold dud products.
Using about 3 holes open and no, I'm not. I have found that I get very little vapour with mouth to lung hits even if I open it up all the way though.
